name: Auto Snapshot
description: Take automatic snapshots of the project metadata while in development.

system-settings.name: Enable for Practice / Just for fun projects

Design Change Settle Window (in minutes)
Optional. A snapshot is taken only after this many minutes have passed with no further data dictionary changes, so a multi-edit Online Designer session (including natural pauses to test a field or survey before coming back to adjust it) is captured once at its clean end-state rather than mid-edit. Checked once per cron run (every 30 minutes by default -- see cron_frequency in config.json), so actual latency is this value plus up to one cron interval. Leave blank to use the default of 60 minutes.

Maximum Staleness Before Forced Snapshot (in hours)
Optional. Safety valve for projects edited near-continuously, which might otherwise never go quiet long enough to satisfy the settle window above. If a design change has been pending this many hours without settling, a snapshot is taken anyway. Leave blank to use the default of 12 hours.

Snapshot Retention Count
Optional. The number of automated snapshots to keep per project; older automated snapshots beyond this count are deleted by the separate "Prune Old Snapshots" cron. Snapshots taken manually (via the Design page's own "Create Snapshot" button) are never deleted, regardless of this setting. Leave blank or enter 0 to disable pruning entirely -- no automated snapshot is ever deleted. Can be overridden per project below.
system-settings.project-name:
Snapshot Retention Count Override
Leave blank to use the system-wide default.

crons.cron_description: Checks for project metadata changes and takes a data dictionary snapshot.
Deletes automated data dictionary snapshots beyond the configured retention count.
